summary: Civil suit for land partition under Assam Land Revenue Regulation 1886; proceeding through sale deeds 1977, 1981 trial court decree overturned on remand; 2004 partition suit dismissed by trial court; appellate court allowed recovery of exclusive possession; high court quashed appellate decree citing section 154(1)(e) bar; clarified partition requires actual possession, court jurisdiction bars; explored joint ownership, procedural stages.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure 1908, O. XX Rule 18
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment affirmed; civil court jurisdiction barred under s.154(1)(e); partition denied without actual possession.
